notes.title: Build update 5634 and TRAIN CONSTRUCTION Bundle
notes.notes:
Hello fellow train enthusiasts! 

We hope you are enjoying A-Train 9 V5.0. We have a new update to fix a few issues with the game. Thank you for your reports and please let us know if you find anything else

  

・In Option > Side Menu, correction to "Display target information" and "Display timer” which were inverted

・Fix to the Ecological power translation

　Ecology power　→　Green power

・Fixing the fanfare for the achievements on funds, power, green power, track length

・Fix to the warning message displayed when you try to change the rails on which a train is currently running



Also we are happy to announce that there is now a bundle to buy A-Train 9 V5.0 : Japan Train Simulator Ultimate Edition and A-Train9 TRAIN CONSTRUCTION together at a discount, so you can choose to add the hundreds of train from the TRAIN CONTRSUCTION workshop to your game, or design your own!



We hope you continue to enjoy the game!
